ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixel field with approximately 5-10% distribution of high-intensity (white) focal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Discontinuous, high-contrast white circular and semi-circular blobs scattered across the dark ventral surface, with increased spatial density at the distal tips and medial trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex and an approximate internal pixel-angle of 50-60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire horizontal boundary; significant pixel-amplitude variation in the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature originating from the median notch and tapering to pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and annular high-contrast pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed across both lobes, notably clustered on the left distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, high-intensity linear pixel disruption (~45-degree angle) located on the upper quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of protruding, high-intensity structural elements consistent with active barnacle colonization visible on the extreme outer edges and tips.
